themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements across Europe and South America are actively mobilizing for upcoming electoral battles by rolling out major policy platforms and contesting government legitimacy. Party leaders are positioning themselves as government-in-waiting through high-profile policy presentations and aggressive opposition attacks.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Intensive campaigning and policy rollouts ahead of the 29N elections while pressuring the PP over coalition terms

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen launching major policy platforms, including pension and baccalaureate reforms, for the 2027 presidential race

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Karina Milei and Patricia Bullrich mobilizing legislative strategies while figures project a first-round win in 2027

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fierce parliamentary clashes as opposition leader Magyar Péter demands Fidesz resignations amidst corruption scandals

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are escalating demands for radical border control measures, featuring parallel calls for military deployment and offshore processing centers. Parties across multiple countries are framing illegal migration as an intolerable invasion threatening national sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Abascal demands naval blockades in the Canaries and endorses Rwanda-style offshore deportation centers

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP champions proposals to process and house asylum seekers in return centers located in Rwanda

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage and Tice attack government expenditure on illegal migrant housing and demand transparency on migrant crime

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing factions are condemning judicial restrictions, state bans, and legal actions targeting their leaders as anti-democratic overreach. Factions frame court rulings and state oversight as partisan weaponization designed to neutralize political opposition.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Bolsonaristas denounce Supreme Court Justice Moraes' veto on visiting Jair Bolsonaro as an arbitrary abuse of power

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces renewed push from state ministers in the Bundesrat to initiate formal party ban proceedings (AfD-Verbot)

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei administration experiences ongoing legal friction and court battles with political opposition and labor unions

themes.title: Foreign Aid Rollbacks and Skepticism Toward Ukraine Support
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are increasing pressure to scale back foreign assistance and military aid to Ukraine. Factions cite domestic economic hardship and risks of regional escalation to justify calls for immediate aid rollbacks.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen vows to cut off French aid to Ukraine upon taking power, citing lack of domestic funds

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Opinion polling shows a majority of FrP voters believe Norway is providing excessive aid to Ukraine

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz links Russian drone strikes in Transcarpathia to pro-Ukraine policies while Tisza orders border transit halts

themes.title: Anti-Establishment Hostility to Public Media and Information Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements are attacking public service broadcasters and state media agreements, alleging partisan bias and censorship. Parties are calling for structural defunding, opting out of broadcast treaties, or directly confronting media outlets.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Abascal and Vox clash with public TV producers over alleged censorship and editing of a major interview

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD blocks state digital media treaties and demands exiting public broadcasting funding systems in East Germany

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Government coalition faces sustained criticism and internal maneuvering over editorial control of state broadcaster RAI
